description: Creates the swap and returns the payment instruction: the one-time deposit address, the memo if the chain needs one, the exact amount in decimal and in base units with the decimals and token contract as listed by the provider, a wallet URI where a standard exists (BIP-21, ERC-681, Solana Pay, Monero, TON), and the status URL. Use it only when you control the wallet at fromAddress and will send the deposit yourself; for a person use get_swap_page_link, so they create the swap on the page with both addresses in front of them. The deposit must come from fromAddress. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two swaps. There is no cancellation; a swap that cannot be completed is handled by support from the swap id. Floating rate: the final amount is set when the deposit confirms. Limited to 10 creations a minute per IP.

amount.description: decimal amount you send, as a string, within get_limits

extraId.description: memo / destination tag / payment ID for the receiving side, only where that asset needs one

from.description: asset slug you send, e.g. usdt-trc20

fromAddress.description: the address you will send the deposit from (a wallet you control)

fromExtraId.description: the sending side's extra id, only if your wallet attaches one

mode.description: standard (default), or private: the swap runs as two legs at two providers through an intermediate coin; the response then carries legs[]

rateId.description: fixed only: the rateId of a get_quote answer with rateType=fixed, used once within about a minute

rateType.description: floating (default): an estimate settled when the deposit confirms; fixed: a held amount under a rateId for about a minute to create the swap with, then the order's own deposit deadline (payTill)

refundAddress.description: fixed only, required: an address on the sending network that the deposit returns to if the fixed-rate swap cannot be completed (usually the address you send from)

refundExtraId.description: fixed only: the extra id of the refund address, where the sending asset uses one

to.description: asset slug to receive, e.g. btc

toAddress.description: the receiving address for the `to` asset

via.description: private mode only: the intermediate coin slug; omitted → the server picks among sol, trx, ltc; xmr on request (the hop runs on Monero)

name: create_swap
title: Create a swap (for an agent that controls the sending wallet)
